newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme Corp Q4 revenues rise 39 percent.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme Corp Q4 revenues rise 39 percent.

text.p: Genzyme Corp's said Tuesday that fourth quarter revenues were $145 million, up 39 percent from $105 million in the year-ago quarter.

The company said product and service sales in the quarter rose 43 percent to $139 million. Ceredase and Cerezyme, enzyme replacement therapies to treat an enzyme disorder known as Gaucher's disease, generated $72 million in sales for the quarter, up 26 percent from 1995 sales of $57 million.
Genzyme said 1996 full-year revenues rose 35 percent to $512 million from $379 million in 1995.
